title: Audit repair group3: office, notices and backup recovery

items.scope: Show retryable office email-history and individual-email load errors; empty history only after successful empty response.
Distinguish failed EIN details retrieval from missing client numbers; retry and show assistant answers only after successful retrieval.
Preserve the Florida document number on replacement Articles for both signing paths, or use a supplied validated correction.
Send registered-agent notices, receipts and resignation copies to the current account email; preserve original intake contact fields.

Mark restored unfinished S elections needing taxpayer-number re-entry, display the required portal action and automatically notify; handle missing secret when EIN arrives even without a prior package. Keep temporary secrets excluded from backups.
